name: Plume USD
oneLiner: pUSD wraps USDC 1:1 in Plume-managed Nucleus BoringVaults, with no protocol mint/redemption fees; cross-chain redemption can remain pending for up to 12 hours.

dependencyReview.rationale: Plume explicitly describes pUSD as a non-interest-bearing wrapper of USDC, previously USDC.e, minted and redeemed 1:1 through Plume-managed Nucleus BoringVaults. The canonical parent is USDC with serial wrapper semantics. Compliance checks, vault control, cross-chain redemption delays and the legacy bridged representation remain local claim risks.

relationships.reason: Issuer-documented 1:1 USDC wrapper; legacy USDC.e is retained as a bridge-qualified look-through rather than a fictitious tracked parent.

collateral: 1:1 backed by USDC deposited into a Nucleus BoringVault
pegMechanism: Mint/redeem at 1:1 for USDC on Ethereum or Plume with no protocol fees. Cross-chain redemption can take up to 12 hours; the issuer documents a predicate-proxy mint gateway with off-chain compliance checks.

mechanismArchetypeReview.rationale: Plume pUSD is minted and redeemed against approved dollar stablecoins held in its reserve vault.
